notes: Adds an always-on crash log written next to the app itself. Release builds had zero panic visibility until now -- if Sotrice ever vanishes without a dialog again, crash.log will say exactly what happened instead of nothing at all. Tried to reproduce the specific crash that prompted this (repeated cold starts, ~8.5 minutes of runtime across two launches) and could not -- shipping the crash log regardless so the next occurrence, if there is one, is actually diagnosable.
